experimentalPolicy: Service-supported cautious lender: preserve existing Business commitments and at least one Business banker; reserve up to three Retail staff; preserve Operations minimum; lend with remaining staff; margin deposit pricing; recruit only from protected cash and an operating surplus that covers added payroll plus 10K. Same commercial-office expansion limits and existing servicing provider. Human decisions only, not altered engine, AI, or save rules.
scope: Bounded prospective human-policy comparison against an ordinary same-rule rival. Service-supported allocation, margin pricing and an operating-surplus recruitment guard replace the prior lending-heavy allocation; existing obligations, protected cash, construction limits and finite work remain. No injected resources, changed yields or rules, revived endings or subsidiary mandates. Not a pure one-variable intervention, optimal play or final balance acceptance. Service-aware variant: deliberate strategies may buy existing relationship-service capacity after final staffing, using current cash, protected work and a net-improving forecast. This is a human-policy comparison, not changed AI or saved rules.
